notes: Selected AT0003 intervention-effectiveness evidence as the highest-value safe substantive improvement after calibration gained two preregistered predictions and baseline coverage reached all top-level categories. Added E0006 from a Campbell systematic review of 107 youth active-labour-market interventions in 31 countries. The record preserves the mixed result: small positive average employment/earnings effects, significant averages for skills training and entrepreneurship promotion, negligible or statistically insignificant effects for employment services and subsidized employment, non-significant business-performance effects, substantial heterogeneity, limited cost evidence, and the important limitation that searches ended in January 2015. This strengthens P07 without equating resource existence or pooled averages with effectiveness or cost-effectiveness. No external PR was merged, no protected path was changed, no consequential external action was taken, and no new human-review condition was created.
